description: This Kotlin source file defines a custom preference component 'TimePickerPreference' for an Android application, allowing users to select and store a time value with a user-friendly summary.

classes.name: TimePickerPreference
classes.description: A custom dialog preference for selecting a time, storing it as minutes since midnight, and displaying a formatted time string.

methods.name: onGetDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the default time value as a string from the TypedArray, with a fallback to '480' (8:00 AM).

methods.name: onSetInitialValue
methods.description: Initializes the preference value from persisted storage or uses the default; updates the summary display.

methods.name: updateSummary
methods.description: Updates the preference summary to display the selected time in a user-friendly format.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the stored time in minutes since midnight.

methods.name: setTime
methods.description: Sets the time in minutes, persists the value, and updates the summary display.
